title: Aeration rate fell below recipe for 3 h
symptoms: Aeration rate dropped from 65 to about 40 L/h at 31 h while the setpoint stayed at 65. Off-gas CO2 fell and off-gas O2 rose within 20 min; DO fell to 7.5 mg/L after 50 min.
investigation: FIC-201 output was at 100% but FI-202 confirmed the low flow. Sterile air filter differential pressure PDI-203 had risen from 0.18 to 0.41 bar over two days.
root_cause: Partially blocked sterile air filter limited the air supply.

capa.action: Add a PDI-203 high alarm at 0.35 bar and a daily filter dP check to the shift checklist.
capa.effectiveness: No aeration loss from filter blockage in the next 15 batches: met.

title: Aeration step change during production phase
symptoms: Aeration rate stepped down to about half of recipe at 47 h and recovered at 52 h. Off-gas O2 rose and CO2 fell; DO dipped.
investigation: FIC-201 and FI-202 agreed, so the flow really changed. Compressor C-01 log showed a load-shedding event at that time, triggered by a faulty site-wide pressure switch.
root_cause: Air compressor load-shedding reduced the air supply to FV-201.

capa.action: Replace the faulty pressure switch PS-01; give FV-201 priority in the compressor load-shedding logic.
capa.effectiveness: No load-shedding events in 6 months: met.

title: Air mass flow controller reading drift
symptoms: FIC-201 showed recipe flow but FI-202 read 12% lower for 18 h. DO trended 1 mg/L below the batch profile; off-gas O2 slightly high.
investigation: FIC-201 failed its calibration check (reading 11% high). Process impact assessed as low; productivity within range.
root_cause: Calibration drift of mass flow controller FIC-201 delivered less air than displayed.

capa.action: Shorten FIC-201 calibration interval from 12 to 6 months; add an automatic FIC-201/FI-202 comparison alarm at 5%.
capa.effectiveness: Comparison alarm verified in OQ; no recurrence in 10 batches: met.

title: Aeration valve stuck after maintenance
symptoms: Aeration rate flat at 42 L/h from inoculation to 15 h instead of ramping to 65 L/h. DO low throughout; slow growth.
investigation: Air inlet valve XV-204 had been left at a mechanical stop after maintenance; work order not closed with a functional check.
root_cause: Air inlet valve left mechanically limited after maintenance restricted the aeration rate.

capa.action: Add a functional stroke test of XV-204 to the maintenance close-out checklist.
capa.effectiveness: Checklist used on all 8 subsequent maintenance jobs: met.

title: Agitator trip with DO crash
symptoms: DO fell from 12.5 to 3 mg/L within 15 minutes at 64 h while aeration rate stayed at recipe. Off-gas O2 rose; temperature rose 0.2 K (less mixing at the cooling jacket).
investigation: VSD-240 tripped on over-current; restarted after 22 minutes. Motor bearing found worn at the next shutdown.
root_cause: Agitator drive trip caused by a worn motor bearing stopped oxygen transfer.

capa.action: Add vibration monitoring to M-240 and replace bearings on condition.

title: Agitator speed sensor failure
symptoms: SI-240 read zero for 40 minutes at 120 h while DO, off-gas and temperature stayed normal.
investigation: Process signals showed mixing continued; the sensor cable was damaged. Agitator itself ran normally.
root_cause: Faulty speed sensor cable; no real loss of agitation.

capa.action: Replace SI-240 cable with armoured cable; route away from the walkway.

title: High agitator current from foaming
symptoms: Motor current rose to 118% of profile at 150 h; DO fell slowly; oil feed rate normal.
investigation: Foam level high; antifoam addition restored current. Linked to a slightly low oil feed concentration (see DEV-2025-012).
root_cause: Foam increased agitator load; linked to an oil lot with low antifoam effect.

capa.action: Add foam probe alarm to the operator display.
capa.effectiveness: Alarm in use; no high-current events in 10 batches: met.

title: Sugar feed pump stopped
symptoms: Sugar feed rate dropped to zero at 46 h for 2 h. Oxygen uptake and off-gas CO2 fell; DO rose; base consumption fell.
investigation: P-210 tripped on thermal overload; restart after 2 h. Feed tank weight confirmed no feed.
root_cause: Sugar feed pump trip interrupted substrate supply.

capa.action: Add P-210 run-status alarm to the operator display; spare overload relay stocked.
capa.effectiveness: No unalarmed feed stops in 12 months: met.

title: Sugar feed above profile after a phase change
symptoms: Sugar feed rate ran well above the recipe profile from 128 h to 141 h. Oxygen uptake and CO2 rose, DO fell and base demand rose.
investigation: Feed controller FIC-210 was found to switch to a stale ramp table after the production-phase change: a software configuration error introduced in an unapproved recipe edit.
root_cause: Feed recipe configuration error made the feed controller run above profile after phase changes.

capa.action: Restore validated recipe; lock recipe editing to change control; add automatic recipe checksum verification at batch start.
capa.effectiveness: Checksum verified at start of next 20 batches: met.

title: Feed flow meter fouling
symptoms: FI-211 read 8% above the feed tank weight loss for one shift. Process signals unchanged.
investigation: Sugar crystal deposit on the flow meter; the real feed was correct and the meter over-read.
root_cause: Fouled feed flow meter over-reading; actual feed was within profile.

capa.action: Add hot-water flush of FI-211 to the CIP cycle.
capa.effectiveness: No reconciliation failures in 10 batches: met.

title: Feed line partial blockage
symptoms: Sugar feed rate fell to 60% of profile over 6 hours at 130 h; pump speed at maximum. DO rose; oxygen uptake and CO2 fell.
investigation: Blockage found at the feed line check valve; caramelised sugar after a steam-in-place cycle.
root_cause: Partial blockage of the sugar feed line reduced substrate supply.

capa.action: Change SIP sequence to flush the feed line before steaming; inspect check valve every 5 batches.

title: pH probe drift detected by offline sample
symptoms: Online pH read 6.50 while the offline sample read 6.31 at 96 h. Base flow had risen 35% over 20 hours with feed unchanged.
investigation: AE-220 slope found at 88% after the batch; reference junction partly blocked. Controller had been holding a false reading.
root_cause: pH probe drift: the controller held a wrong pH because the measurement was wrong.

capa.action: Add a mid-batch offline pH check at 72 h; replace probes after 10 batches.
capa.effectiveness: No undetected drift >0.10 in 12 months: met.

title: Intermittent pH reading offset
symptoms: Online pH moved away from 6.50 at 112–119 h; the controller changed base flow in response. Temperature, feeds and aeration unchanged.
investigation: Offline pH at 115 h disagreed with online pH by 0.24. Probe AE-220 cable connector had moisture ingress, giving an offset that came and went.
root_cause: Intermittent pH measurement offset from a wet probe connector.

capa.action: Replace connector with sealed type; add connector inspection to pre-batch checklist.

title: pH probe calibration out of limits not detected
symptoms: Pre-batch calibration record showed slope 93%, below the 95% limit, but the batch was started.
investigation: Calibration record reviewed only after the batch. Offline samples agreed within 0.05, so no process impact.
root_cause: Procedure gap: no hard stop for a failed calibration before sterilisation.

capa.action: Electronic calibration record now blocks batch start on a failed slope.

title: Base pump failure, pH fell
symptoms: Base flow dropped to zero at 58 h while the controller output was 100%. pH fell to 6.2 over 3 hours; offline pH agreed with online.
investigation: Base pump P-221 diaphragm ruptured.
root_cause: Base dosing pump failure: real pH drop.

capa.action: Install a flow switch on the base line with an alarm when output >50% and no flow.
capa.effectiveness: No unalarmed dosing failures in 12 months: met.

title: Acid pump running continuously
symptoms: Acid flow present for 2 h at 110 h although pH was below setpoint; pH fell to 6.35; offline pH confirmed.
investigation: Acid pump P-222 start relay welded closed.
root_cause: Acid dosing pump stuck on: real pH drop.

capa.action: Replace relay; add acid-flow-when-pH-low interlock.
capa.effectiveness: Interlock tested; no recurrence in 10 batches: met.

title: Base concentration wrong after tank change
symptoms: Base consumption doubled after a base tank change at 90 h; pH held at setpoint; offline pH agreed.
investigation: New base solution prepared at half concentration.
root_cause: Base solution prepared at the wrong concentration (preparation error).

capa.action: Add conductivity check of base solution before connection.
capa.effectiveness: Check performed on all tank changes in 3 months: met.

title: Chilled water supply interruption
symptoms: Temperature rose from 298.0 to 298.9 K at 150–162 h with cooling valve TV-231 fully open. Both probes agreed.
investigation: Utilities log showed the chilled-water loop at reduced capacity during chiller maintenance; Fermentation was not informed.
root_cause: Reduced chilled-water supply during chiller maintenance.

capa.action: Utilities to notify Fermentation before any chiller work; add loop-temperature signal to the FV-201 display.
capa.effectiveness: Notifications given for all 4 later maintenance events: met.

title: Cooling valve actuator failure
symptoms: Temperature rose to 298.7 K over 5 hours at 140 h; TIC-230 output at 100% but cooling water flow stayed low.
investigation: TV-231 actuator diaphragm leaking; valve could not open fully.
root_cause: Cooling water valve actuator failure limited cooling.

capa.action: Add valve position feedback and a deviation alarm between output and position.

title: Temperature high during summer peak
symptoms: Temperature held at 298.4 K for 6 hours at 100 h during a heatwave; cooling valve fully open; both probes agreed.
investigation: Chilled-water loop return temperature 3 K above design during the heatwave.
root_cause: Insufficient chilled-water capacity at high ambient temperature.

capa.action: Engineering study for chiller capacity; interim: schedule peak-heat batch phases at night.
capa.effectiveness: Study completed; interim measure in place: met.

title: Temperature probe failure
symptoms: TE-230A read 299.2 K while TE-230B read 298.0 K at 186 h; controller was on TE-230A and opened cooling fully, cooling the broth to 297.4 K by TE-230B.
investigation: TE-230A element damaged; controller selected the wrong probe because the probe-selection logic used the higher reading.
root_cause: Failed temperature probe and probe-selection logic caused over-cooling.

capa.action: Controller now uses the average of both probes and alarms at 0.2 K difference.

title: Probe calibration offset after replacement
symptoms: Both probes agreed but read 0.4 K below the calibrated reference thermometer during the post-batch check.
investigation: Replacement probes had been installed without updating the transmitter offset.
root_cause: Calibration offset not applied after a like-for-like probe replacement.

capa.action: Add transmitter offset verification to the probe replacement work instruction.

title: Intermittent temperature signal spikes
symptoms: Short spikes of +1 K on TE-230B lasting seconds, 14 times over 30 h; TE-230A steady; no controller response.
investigation: Loose terminal in the junction box.
root_cause: Loose wiring on a temperature transmitter.

capa.action: Tighten and inspect junction box terminals each shutdown.

title: Back-pressure valve sticking
symptoms: Head pressure swung between 0.6 and 1.3 bar for 4 h at 160 h; DO followed the pressure; aeration steady.
investigation: PV-260 positioner sticking.
root_cause: Sticking back-pressure valve positioner.

capa.action: Replace positioner; add PV-260 to preventive maintenance.

title: Exhaust filter blockage raised head pressure
symptoms: Head pressure rose slowly from 0.9 to 1.4 bar over 12 h; DO rose; aeration flow fell slightly as back-pressure increased.
investigation: Exhaust filter wetted by foam carry-over.
root_cause: Wet exhaust filter after foaming raised vessel pressure.

capa.action: Install exhaust filter heater; link foam alarm to antifoam addition.

title: Pressure transmitter failure
symptoms: PT-260 read 0 bar for 2 h; DO and off-gas normal.
investigation: Transmitter power supply fuse blown; actual pressure normal by local gauge.
root_cause: Failed pressure transmitter power supply; no process impact.

capa.action: Add redundant power supply to PT-260.

title: PAA overdose
symptoms: PAA flow ran at 18 L/h for 5 h from 60 h (normal up to 11). Oxygen uptake fell slowly over the next 10 h; final titre 20% low.
investigation: PAA pump P-250 speed setpoint entered in the wrong units after a recipe change.
root_cause: PAA overdose from a recipe unit error; toxic to the culture.

capa.action: Add high-limit interlock on PAA flow; recipe change review by a second person.

title: PAA feed interruption
symptoms: PAA flow zero for 3 h at 140 h; little immediate change in online signals.
investigation: PAA tank empty: refill missed at shift change.
root_cause: PAA tank ran empty: refill missed.

capa.action: Add low-level alarm on PAA tank.

title: PAA flow meter reconciliation failure
symptoms: FI-251 totaliser 7% above tank level change over 24 h.
investigation: Flow meter zero drift; actual feed correct.
root_cause: PAA flow meter zero drift.

capa.action: Add monthly zero check for FI-251.

title: Oil feed pump cavitation
symptoms: Oil flow oscillated between 15 and 35 L/h for 8 h at 180 h; slight foam increase.
investigation: Air in the oil suction line after tank change.
root_cause: Oil pump cavitation after a tank change.

capa.action: Add venting step to the oil tank change instruction.

title: Oil lot with low antifoam effect
symptoms: Foaming increased from 140 h; agitator current rose (see DEV-2025-011).
investigation: Oil lot complied with specification but was at the low end of the antifoam component.
root_cause: Oil lot at the low end of specification for antifoam content.

capa.action: Tighten supplier specification for antifoam content.

title: Bacterial contamination
symptoms: From 50 h oxygen uptake and CO2 rose steadily above the batch profile with feeds unchanged; base demand rose; foaming at 70 h.
investigation: Microscopy at 72 h showed rod-shaped bacteria; plating confirmed Bacillus sp. Agitator seal water found contaminated.
root_cause: Contamination through the agitator mechanical seal.

capa.action: Replace seal; add seal water bioburden testing weekly.

title: Suspected contamination not confirmed
symptoms: Oxygen uptake 10% above profile from 90 h; feeds unchanged.
investigation: Microscopy and plating negative. Feed solution lot had 4% higher sugar concentration within specification.
root_cause: Not contamination: higher (in-spec) sugar concentration in the feed lot.

capa.action: None required; recorded for trending.

title: Yeast contamination via sample valve
symptoms: Gradual pH fall corrected by more base from 110 h; oxygen uptake above profile; titre 30% low.
investigation: Yeast confirmed by plating; sample valve steam trap failed.
root_cause: Contamination through the sample valve after steam trap failure.

capa.action: Replace steam trap; add temperature monitoring on sample valve steaming.

title: Sugar feed solution below concentration
symptoms: Oxygen uptake and CO2 below profile from 40 h with the sugar feed rate exactly on recipe; DO above profile.
investigation: Feed solution lot tested at 82% of nominal concentration; dilution error at the supplier.
root_cause: Sugar feed solution lot under strength: feed rate correct but substrate delivered was low.

capa.action: Add incoming concentration test (refractometry) to sugar lot release.
capa.effectiveness: Test in use for all lots: met.

title: Media component lot change slowed growth
symptoms: Slower growth in the first 30 h in three consecutive batches using a new corn steep liquor lot.
investigation: Lot met specification; nitrogen content at the low end.
root_cause: Media component lot at the low end of specification.

capa.action: Add nitrogen content to supplier quality agreement trending.

title: Base solution lot contaminated with particulates
symptoms: Base line filter blocked at 70 h; base flow fell; pH dipped to 6.42 before filter change.
investigation: Base lot contained particulates from a damaged drum liner.
root_cause: Particulates in a base solution lot blocked the dosing filter.

capa.action: Visual inspection of drum liners at receipt.

title: Manual aeration change without approval
symptoms: Aeration rate set to 55 L/h for 2 h at 30 h; no batch record entry.
investigation: Operator reduced aeration to control foam without supervisor approval. Procedure and system causes examined: the foam alarm had no defined response, which contributed.
root_cause: Unapproved manual change, made easier by a missing foam-response instruction.

capa.action: Add foam response instruction to SOP-FER-001; retrain operators.
capa.effectiveness: No unapproved changes in 3 months: met.

title: Wrong feed profile selected at batch start
symptoms: Sugar feed followed the seed fermenter profile for the first 12 h.
investigation: Operator selected the wrong recipe; recipe names were similar. System cause: recipe selection screen showed both recipes without a confirmation step.
root_cause: Wrong recipe selected; system design allowed it without confirmation.

capa.action: Rename recipes and add a batch-start confirmation step.

title: Off-gas analyser calibration failure
symptoms: Off-gas CO2 and O2 shifted together by about 5% with all inputs steady; DO unchanged.
investigation: AE-265 weekly calibration failed; reference gas cylinder near empty.
root_cause: Off-gas analyser out of calibration; no process change.

capa.action: Add reference gas cylinder pressure alarm.
